entries.text: Over the last few years, the cost of living has surged.
But why? It started with a perfect storm.
First: Supply Chain Disruptions. Pandemic-era shutdowns broke the flow of goods.
Second: Energy Shocks. Geopolitical tensions sent gas and electricity prices soaring.
And third: Stimulus and Demand. More money chasing fewer goods.
To fight back, the Federal Reserve raised interest rates.
The goal: cool the economy without triggering a recession.
Inflation is easing, but the impact remains.
